# Bilingual Demo

English | 简体中文

![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/x/y/ci.svg) [![npm-version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/demo.svg)][npm-url] [![downloads][dl-img]][dl-url] [npm-url]: https://www.npmjs.com/package/demo [dl-img]: https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/demo.svg [dl-url]: https://www.npmjs.com/package/demo A demo library for the plugin's own tests. The default README is written in English, but the repository keeps a short Chinese section inside the very same file — that is the shape `zh_section` is supposed to detect, and the previous probe (2026-10-06) found zero of these among 29 repos on this machine's boards, so this body is synthesized on purpose. ## Features * Runs in the browser and on the server. * Zero dependencies, zero build step. * Ships typed definitions for every public entry point. ## Why another demo Most of the tools in this corner of the ecosystem either pull in a transpiler or insist on a registry round trip before you can read a single line of source. This one is a single file: you copy it into your project, you read it, you change it. The public surface is three functions and one event emitter, which is deliberately small — the point of the repository is the shape of a readable package, not the number of options it exposes. ## Quick start ```js # 这一行在围栏代码块里，开头是个井号：朴素切分器会把它当成语义标题， # 于是段名取到「这一行在围栏代码块里…」，界面上就当小标题念了出来（真机读数是 QwenLM/Qwen 的 token_ids 那一行）。 const demo = require('bilingual-demo'); demo.run({ locale: '中文说明' }); // 这里的中文同样不该进判据 ``` Call `run` once at startup. It reads the environment, picks a transport, and returns a handle you can pass around. Nothing else in the package needs initialization, and there is no background timer, so a test process can exit on its own without an explicit teardown step. ## Configuration | Option | Default | Notes | | :----- | :------ | :---- | | `locale` | `en` | Language tag only, no translation table ships with it | | `retries` | `2` | Per request, not per run | | `logger` | `null` | Anything with a `warn` method works | The table above is the whole contract. Options that are not listed here are not read at runtime, which is a stronger guarantee than the usual "we ignore unknown keys" sentence, and it is the reason this package has no validation layer to speak of. ## 中文说明 这个仓库把中文介绍直接嵌在默认的 README 里面，没有另存一份 README-zh_CN.md。 上面那段英文讲的是同一件事：库在浏览器和服务器都能跑，零依赖，也没有构建步骤。 用法是把包名写进依赖表，然后调用 run 方法；配置项都写在下一节。 ### 更多中文 这一段也是中文，但它排在上面那段之后，所以按文档顺序命中的必须是前一段。 判据取第一段达标的正文，展示与判定吃同一份文本，这样界面上的节选就不会和判据看到的不是同一段。 ## License MIT
